## Problem or opportunity

Describe the technical problem, research question, or governance gap.

## Proposed contribution

Explain the smallest useful change you want to make.

## Security / governance invariant

State which invariant, threat, trust boundary, or release-control property is affected.

## Verification

Describe how the contribution can be tested or independently reviewed.

## Collaboration

If this is genuinely co-developed, list the contributors who should be credited as co-authors.
